[SWS_DM_00894] Notification event upon
snapshot record
updates
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04148, RS_Diag_04091
⌈
After the DM has captured and stored a new
snapshot record
or overwritten an
existing
snapshot record
with new data and there is a registered update notifi-
cation via the function
ara::diag::DTCInformation::SetSnapshotRecordUp-
datedNotifier
, the DM shall call this notifier for each
snapshot record
update.
⌋
In case of
• deletion (7.3.4.4.5)
• aging (7.3.4.4.6)
